summary: Nine concrete, comment-endorsed tools, guides, and places surfaced from 30 fully crawled front-page stories.
telegram_footer: 9 items surfaced | 30/30 current front-page stories processed | history + run artifact updated.

items.name: Brolly
items.source_story_title: Show HN: Brolly, a plain-text weather forecast site
items.summary: A compact, text-first weather forecast site with mobile-friendly interactivity.
items.why_included: A commenter preferred it to wttr.in for interactive, narrow-screen weather checks.
items.evidence: One commenter praised Brolly’s interactivity and better mobile experience than wttr.in.

evidence_sources.author: speerer
evidence_sources.excerpt: Love it. This reminds me of wttr.in, but with the benefit of interactivity and that it works much better on mobile.

items.name: Didder
items.summary: A dithering tool for image conversion, including six-color e-ink preparation.
items.why_included: It is a concrete, first-hand recommendation for practical e-ink image preprocessing.
items.evidence: A commenter called Didder a good dithering tool and described using it for six-color e-ink displays.

evidence_sources.author: ectoloph
evidence_sources.excerpt: Didder[0] is a good tool for dithering. I use it to pre-process images for the 6-color e-ink displays.

items.name: Juice
items.summary: An interactive visual explainer for adding satisfying feedback to interface controls.
items.why_included: It is a specific, enthusiastically endorsed resource for studying interaction polish.
items.evidence: A commenter described the site as an amazing demonstration of visual, audio, and haptic interface feedback.

evidence_sources.author: 1zael
evidence_sources.excerpt: Brad Woods has an amazing website dynamically illustrating the concept of "juice"

evidence_sources.author: chrisweekly
evidence_sources.excerpt: Yes! Awesome site and post, I'd forgotten about it. Thanks for sharing!

items.name: wireproxy
items.summary: A WireGuard-to-SOCKS proxy for routing selected browser containers through specific VPNs.
items.why_included: It was directly recommended as a practical way to route individual containers through WireGuard-capable VPNs.
items.evidence: A commenter described pairing wireproxy with browser containers as extremely useful for per-container VPN routing.

evidence_sources.author: nbaksalyar
evidence_sources.excerpt: I pair it with wireproxy [0]. This way you can assign any Wireguard-capable VPN for specific containers. It's extremely useful.

items.name: MouthPad
items.summary: A tongue-controlled touchpad designed to provide hands-free computer access.
items.why_included: It received a clear use-case endorsement from someone who relies on alternative input during medical treatment.
items.evidence: A commenter who uses head, eye, and facial tracking said they would really love this device.

evidence_sources.author: arm32
evidence_sources.excerpt: As someone who uses head, eye and facial gesture tracking regularly while doing long medical treatments which tie up both my hands, I would really love something like this.

items.name: Understanding Kubernetes
items.source_story_title: Open-weight AI is having its Kubernetes moment
items.summary: A hands-on exercise series for building intuition about Docker and Kubernetes.
items.why_included: It is a concrete learning resource backed by a first-hand endorsement after completing the exercises.
items.evidence: A commenter called the exercises neat and wished they had learned Kubernetes through them earlier.

evidence_sources.author: chias
evidence_sources.excerpt: It's actually really neat, i wish i had bothered to learn it years ago.

items.name: Meguro Parasitological Museum
items.summary: A Tokyo museum dedicated to parasites and parasitology exhibits.
items.why_included: It is a strongly endorsed, distinctive Tokyo stop surfaced in a museum recommendation thread.
items.evidence: A commenter called the museum fantastic and highly recommended it.

evidence_sources.author: cl42
evidence_sources.excerpt: Meguro Parasitological Museum is fantastic and en...grossing. :) It's a fun area to visit in general. Highly recommend it.

items.name: Dr Becky
items.source_story_title: Charles Ross spent 50 yrs building Star Axis naked-eye observatory in New Mexico
items.summary: A science video channel covering astronomy and space policy with energetic commentary.
items.why_included: A commenter specifically highlighted the presenter’s knowledge and infectious enthusiasm.
items.evidence: A commenter recommended a recent Dr Becky episode and praised her knowledge and enthusiasm.

evidence_sources.author: ck2
evidence_sources.excerpt: her knowledge + enthusiasm is infectious, love it

items.name: MapComplete Bookcases
items.source_story_title: Book Corners: Community map of neighborhood book exchange spots
items.summary: An OpenStreetMap-based map for finding and contributing neighborhood bookcases.
items.why_included: It is a concrete community mapping tool recommended as a better shared database for book exchanges.
items.evidence: Its creator recommended contributing to OpenStreetMap through the Bookcases map.

evidence_sources.author: pietervdvn
evidence_sources.excerpt: we'd better all contribute to OpenStreetMap
